verdict.rationale: Docs show founders can generate and e-sign a Convertible Note in-platform (docs-21, docs-22, docs-37) and that award/agreement documents are automatically tied to cap table records via smart-linking (docs-7, docs-34), supporting the notes-to-cap-table linkage. However, SAFEs specifically are never mentioned, and there is no explicit description of how conversion terms (valuation cap, discount) are modeled or reflected in cap table math. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE support, and documentation of automatic conversion-term modeling on the cap table.
